responses.response: Good afternoon, Adhithyan. All systems online. How can I help you today?

An AI agent is a system that pursues a goal by reasoning in a loop: it plans, chooses a tool, acts, observes the result, and repeats until the task is done. Unlike a single prompt-and-response, an agent decides its own next step. Everything you see me do on screen right now is that loop made visible.

Multimodal AI means a model can understand more than just text. It can reason over images, audio, and documents together. I combine voice input, language reasoning, and on-screen generation into a single experience, which is multimodal interaction in practice.

A large language model is a neural network trained on vast amounts of text to predict what comes next. That simple objective, at scale, produces the ability to reason, write code, and hold a conversation. I use one as my reasoning core.

I am EDEN, which stands for Everything Done Effortlessly, Naturally. I am a demonstration of modern AI as an interactive system: I listen, I reason, I create software, and I collaborate. I am not a chatbot. I am a companion built to show what today's AI can do.
I can build that. Give me the idea and I will plan the architecture, generate the files, write the code, validate it, and run it for you, live.
You're welcome. It was my pleasure to demonstrate.

default: That's a great question. In this presentation mode I'm running from a scripted knowledge base, so let me focus on what I do best: reasoning, voice interaction, and building software on demand.
